description: Merge preintegrated reference tables sharing a scalar factor and flatten eligible full-tensor contractions.

selection: Merge only equal scalar factors with identical output maps and dimensions. Flatten only full contiguous tensors with multiple factors and fewer merged terms. Keep constant-argument partial contractions unchanged. Unmerged contractions keep their original loop layout.

validation.full_suite_note: Full suites and targeted preintegration tests ran with the final conservative selection.
validation.mypy: Seven existing diagnostics; no new diagnostics.

reproduction: Use separate Python environments for baseline and candidate; run this revision's benchmark driver with each environment for source generation. Set PYTHONHASHSEED=0.
python benchmarks/forms.py generate DIR --revision REVISION --geometry affine
python benchmarks/forms.py generate DIR --revision REVISION --geometry nonaffine

python benchmarks/forms.py compare --variant before=BASELINE_DIR --variant after=CANDIDATE_DIR --filter REGEX_OF_CHANGED_CASES --cc gcc-16 clang-22 --flags="-O3 -march=native -ffp-contract=fast" --cpu 2 --duration 0.1 --repetitions 9 --output strict.json

Repeat comparison with -ffast-math appended. For main/release comparisons, use --variant pr=CANDIDATE_DIR --variant main=MAIN_DIR --variant release=RELEASE_DIR and select the six forms in baselines.results.
